dot_model: A borderless three-row table. The first and third rows contain one cell with WIDTH=fullWidth and COLSPAN=3. The middle row contains an empty cell, one FIXEDSIZE=TRUE WIDTH=12 HEIGHT=12 PORT=P cell, and another empty cell.

input_model.label_width: Java AWT measured external state-border label width
input_model.threshold: appendLabelHtmlSpecialForPort casts label_width to int, then selects HTML only when that integer is greater than 40

derivation: The DOT model above was transcribed from the pinned Java method and solved with `dot -Tplain` and `dot -Tsvg`. Node dimensions came from plain output; P-cell bounds came from each node polygon in SVG. Replacing an odd-width HTML node with fixed boxes from 149 through 152px in the same Java-emitted graph showed that only the 152px box reproduces the HTML node's rank coordinate: dot ranks the reported 151px table with symmetric 76px half-extents. The formulas reproduce all ten samples and this odd-width envelope before SVG decimal formatting.
